title: Unique Partner | Three Partners Reach Heima AI Innovation Contest Final Six — BiYou Tech Takes Runner-Up
summary: The 2023 Heima AI Innovation Contest, hosted by the Heima AIGC Industry Service Alliance, wrapped in Beijing on November 25. Six Unique Capital partners made the annual Top 30 — BiYou Tech (必优科技), Fada Huiyun (法大慧云), Yizhe AI / 医者AI, WinGo / 文构, Penghu Wuyu (鹏鹄物宇), and Chaohui

html:
Unique Research · Insight / Unique Partner celebration · November 28, 2023

The 2023 Heima AI Innovation Contest, hosted by the Heima AIGC Industry Service Alliance, wrapped in Beijing on November 25. Six Unique Capital partners made the annual Top 30 — BiYou Tech (必优科技), Fada Huiyun (法大慧云), Yizhe AI / 医者AI, WinGo / 文构, Penghu Wuyu (鹏鹄物宇), and Chaohui AI / 超会商拍 — earning recognition across industry, academia, and capital markets.

BiYou Tech, Fada Huiyun, and Yizhe AI advanced to the final six competing for gold, silver, and bronze. With scoring from 5 lead judges and 12 supporting judges, BiYou Tech took runner-up.

Contest backdrop

Partners included startup platform Chuangye Heima plus four leading general LLM firms — Baidu Intelligent Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, iFlytek, and 360 Group — with support from Zhiyuan Research Institute, Zhongguancun Zhiyou AI Research Institute, and 60 investment institutions. Chuangye Heima framed the contest as both a peer showcase for Chinese AI innovation and a chance for founders, institutions, and partners to deepen industry ties.

Launched in August, the three-month contest drew nearly 200 innovative AI application projects nationwide — AI+ packaging, home furnishing, recruiting, packaging design, office, and more. Some already won recognition from LLM leaders and investors in prelims. After three preliminary rounds in Shenzhen, Beijing Chaoyang, and Beijing Tongzhou, more than 30 judges narrowed Top 30 entrants to six final pitchers.

Final podium: champion Collov AI (home GPT), runner-up BiYou Tech, third place Jinyu Intelligence (近屿智能).

Chuangye Heima Chairman Niu Wenwen: 2023 general AI — from algorithms and compute to data applications — brings cross-industry certainty about the future. His message to all reviewed companies: embrace new AI tech with industry–academia–research peers, go beyond certainty, use uncertainty to create new opportunity, and drive new growth.

Unique Partners (financing advisory)

The following projects retain Unique Capital as financing advisor for long-term LP relations and strategic planning. Investment institutions are welcome to reach out for investment and partnership discussions.

BiYou Tech | AI + office. UTalk-Doc is a next-gen document agent for content presentation and expression — helping customers unlock expression in plain language. 10.017 million registered users across 52 countries/regions; break-even in September this year; cumulative commercial revenue RMB 2.83 million. Flagship ChatPPT is among China’s most popular AI productivity tools.

Fada Huiyun | AI + legal. An “AI smart legal” platform deeply merging law with LLMs. Core thesis: standardize enterprise legal-service scenes and deliver “digital platform + AI legal + legal team” integrated services to raise legal-ops efficiency.

Yizhe AI | AI + health management. Tsinghua-origin team focused on LLMs and non-diagnostic personal health management — a personal small model / health twin so everyone has a health steward that knows them better than they do, plus replicating top specialist clinicians’ judgment. Commercialized as of September this year.

WinGo (文构) | AI + financial text data. China’s first AI financial-data platform based on listed-company disclosure text. NLP, deep learning, and AI deeply process massive financial text — word frequency, similar terms, text features — for academic research and quant investment.

Penghu Wuyu | AI + satellite IoT. First to complete space–ground integrated communications protocol star–ground joint debugging for low-cost satellite IoT; global low-cost satellite IoT operator and solutions provider for always-on, end-to-end, all-domain IoT device monitoring and data collection. Core product prototypes (chips/modules, industrial and portable terminals, data platform) ready for trial commercial ops. On June 18, 2022, with leading chip and satellite partners, completed ground protocol, ground chip, and in-orbit satellite joint debugging — first to close the space–ground tech loop with commercializable low-cost satellite IoT service.

Chaohui AI | AI + e-commerce. Focused on AI × e-commerce productivity tools for sellers. Among China’s first full-chain AIGC image solutions for enterprises and early movers applying AIGC image gen to e-commerce. Core product Chaohui.ai is a one-stop AI product-shoot tool targeting traditional shoot cost and inefficiency.

Editor / review: Qiuping. KEEP partner-welcome / celebration tone; inventory type insight.

— END —
